First run exceeded the 600 s foreground limit (644 s; 312 s kernel generation) and was moved to the background by the harness; kernel cache makes reruns 66 s

The assignment's proposed banana delta(m) = delta_1000 mu_1000/mu(m) (E* = const) was tested and rejected: it has the wrong sign; the KL ridge is nearly flat in delta and closer to the onset-matched curve
